description: OMENZ Authorize (GET form): same APPROVE / REVIEW / DECLINE check before paying an x402 endpoint, with query params: url, method, max_price_usd, expected_pay_to, daily_cap_usd, spent_today_usd. Returns reasons + a signed 5-minute authorization code. Never pays the target. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: GET https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/authorize, $0.001 via x402.)

expected_pay_to.description: payout wallet you expect (0x...), to catch swapped payees

max_price_usd.description: most you are willing to pay per call, in USD

method.description: HTTP method of the target endpoint (GET or POST)

name: authorize_get
title: OMENZ Authorize (GET form)
